title: tap_tone_pi Viewer Pack Manifest v1
description: Measurement-only viewer bundle manifest for tap_tone_pi. Contains raw and derived evidence suitable for laboratory-grade visualization without interpretation.

created_at_utc.description: UTC timestamp when the viewer pack was generated.

source_capdir.description: Logical name of the source capture/session directory (not a filesystem path).

detected_phase.description: Detected measurement phase of the source data.

measurement_only.description: Hard assertion that this bundle contains no interpretation, scoring, or recommendations.

interpretation.description: Explicit declaration that interpretive meaning is intentionally absent.

points.description: List of point IDs included in this pack (e.g., ['A1', 'A2', 'B1']). Avoids directory walking.

bending.description: Optional bending stiffness measurements from the same specimen. Critical input for inverse brace engine.

E_L_GPa.description: Longitudinal (along-grain) Young's modulus in GPa. Stiff direction. Typically 9-12 GPa for spruce.

E_C_GPa.description: Cross-grain (transverse) Young's modulus in GPa. Flexible direction. Typically 0.5-0.9 GPa for spruce.

specific_modulus_GPa_per_gcm3.description: E/density ratio. Key figure of merit for acoustic wood. Higher is better.

c_m_s.description: Speed of sound in material (m/s). sqrt(E/rho).

density_g_cm3.description: Material density in g/cm³. Typically 0.35-0.45 for spruce.

span_mm.description: Test span length in mm. Standard is 400mm.

source_bundle.description: Path or SHA256 of source bending measurement bundle for provenance.

orthotropic_ratio.description: E_L / E_C ratio. Should be 8:1 to 18:1 for quality acoustic tonewood.

files.description: List of all files included in the viewer pack.

bundle_sha256.description: SHA256 hash of the canonicalized manifest (excluding this field).

relpath.description: Forward-slash relative path inside the viewer pack.
